youtube.title: Zoomy's Road Trip Colors! (BUMP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 BUMP! Zoomy the car hit a big bump on the road, and all the colors flew away! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Drive along with Zoomy and learn 7 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and pink! Each color comes back one by one in its own place (the road, the ocean, the city, the pond, the sky, the forest and the farm), and you hear the REAL sounds of the car, the bus and the animals. Then sing the road trip song, and stay till the end, because someone is waiting by the fence! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and pink
✔️ Match each color to a real thing: a red car, a yellow bus, a green frog and more
✔️ Hear real car, bus and animal sounds
✔️ Sing a road trip colors song with Zoomy!
